notes.title: Spectrum updated to Version 1.3!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

We just updated Spectrum to version 1.3. Some of the changes we did came from suggestions and feedback gathered from our community. You can check out the full patch notes below.


All Chapters have been renamed on the Steam leaderboards.
Fixed an issue causing Dark Chapters to not be shown on Steam leaderboards.
Minor bug fixes of some stuff we hadn't noticed was there since launch.
Removed mouse lock in-game.
Fixed a bug that caused the World Timer to show up unintentionally on World Select.
Added missing colliders to various objects on some levels.
Aligned some elements on video settings that were off by like a pixel but enough to cause some eye twitching.
Game music should not skip the current track that's playing if the game loses focus.
Changed some stuff under the hood to improve the way we handle saved files.
Centered the end game victory screen to satisfy our OCD needs.
Changed a bunch of stuff internally that helps out the port to other platforms.
Updated the credits (ran out of jokes for this one).


Thank you everyone for your comments and continuous support, we really appreciate it.

The 3D Avenue team

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've been pretty busy with the game's release, but still manged to work on a couple of things for a quick patch, so here it is.

Patch notes:
- Fixed a couple of bugs that were causing levels and worlds to show locked when they were actually unlocked.
- Credits no longer look blurry when Depth of Field is On.

Known bugs:
- Xbox One controller on Windows 10 moves character to the left without pressing anything.
- The game resolution messes up sometimes due to some default settings, if you run into this issue launch the game while holding the Shift key to get a Launch dialog window and choose your preferred settings. (*)

We are loking into those bugs and will continue to work on improving Spectrum, so if you have any comments, or suggestions, feel free to leave us a comment below.

Thanks for your support mites!

Edit:
* Already fixed on recent patch.
